youtube_description:
There is no 'digital arrest' in Indian law. CBI, ED and police do not arrest anyone over a video call (I4C advisory, Oct 2024). Still, Indians lost ₹1,935 crore to 'digital arrest' scams in 2024 (MHA reply in Rajya Sabha, Mar 2025). The trick is fear + isolation: 'don't cut the call, don't tell anyone, transfer money for verification'. Fix: cut the call, tell someone, report on 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: MHA reply, Rajya Sabha (Mar 2025); I4C advisory (Oct 2024).
#samebro #digitalarrest #scamalert #cybersafety #shorts

Video call pe 'CBI officer': 'aap digital arrest mein ho, call cut mat karna, kisi ko mat batana.' 😨 Truth: digital arrest naam ki koi cheez law mein hai hi nahi. CBI/ED/police video call pe arrest NAHI karte. Phir bhi 2024 mein Indians ne ₹1,935 crore gawaye. Fix: call cut karo, kisi apne ko batao, 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in pe report.
Send this to the friend whose parents pick up every unknown call.
